levels.name: Normal
levels.tagline: dumps its heavy tiles and its doubles early

help.goal: Be the first to play out every tile in your hand. If everyone gets stuck, the lightest hand wins.
steps: The highest double on the table opens the line for you.
On your turn tap a tile that matches one of the two open ends.
If it fits both ends, pick which end from the box that pops up.
Nothing fits? Tap Draw a tile — keep drawing until something does.
Boneyard empty and still stuck? Tap Pass.
notes: Double six set, 28 tiles. Two players get 7 tiles each, three or four get 5.
You may only draw when you truly cannot play, and only pass when the boneyard is empty.
When every player passes in a row the line is blocked: add up the pips, fewest wins.
